title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: Faith and the Power of Heaven (Part 1)
summary: Building on the distinction between action and power, this message explores how the powers of heaven are governed and constrained by individual faith. Citing scriptures from Ether, Moroni, and the Doctrine and Covenants, the review explains that righteous living and hard work are often limited without specific faith to draw down divine intervention. Practical examples include paying tithing effectively, learning foreign languages rapidly, and receiving direct street-level inspiration in missionary work.
